revenueModel.text: The company sells equipment, spares, parts and services to commercial companies, universities and research laboratories in the United States and worldwide.
revenueModel.evidence: These systems, which we market and sell under the CVD, FirstNano and EasyTube® product names, are sold to commercial companies, universities and research laboratories in the United States and throughout the world.

changes.text: The MesoScribe segment ceased operations in 2024 after fulfilling remaining orders and selling related equipment and intellectual property.
changes.evidence: The Company fulfilled remaining orders for MesoScribe products during 2024 at which time it ceased operations of MesoScribe and recorded a $ 0.7 million gain upon the completion of the sale of the equipment during the year ended December 31, 2024.
